title: Measuring What Matters in the Age of AI: The Research Software Metrics Landscape
abstract: arXiv:2611.23253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Research software now serves as a primary instrument of science, but the methods the community uses to judge its quality, sustainability, reuse, and impact remain scattered across software engineering, open science, FAIR software, citation, and research-assessment literature. AI-assisted development sharpens the problem: code can be produced at rates that outpace human review capacity, provenance and attribution are harder to track, scholarly credit systems cannot keep pace, and existing metrics inherit assumptions about how research software gets developed that may no longer apply. To aid in navigating these challenges, we present a focused landscape synthesis of research software metrics based on 49 substantive references, organizing the recurring metrics into eight families described by data source, claimed construct, evidence of validity, automation potential, and susceptibility to misuse. translated_title: AI时代衡量真正重要的东西：研究软件指标全景
translated_abstract: 研究软件如今已成为科学研究的核心工具，但学术界用于评判其质量、可持续性、复用性和影响力的方法仍散落在软件工程、开放科学、FAIR软件、引用和研究评估等多个领域的文献中。AI辅助开发加剧了这一问题：代码生成速度超出了人工审查的能力，来源与归属更难追踪，学术认可体系无法跟上步伐，而现有指标所继承的关于研究软件开发方式的假设可能已不再适用。为帮助应对这些挑战，我们基于49篇实质性参考文献，对研究软件指标进行了聚焦的全景综述，将反复出现的指标归纳为八大类，并从数据来源、所声称的构念、效度证据、自动化潜力以及被滥用的可能性等方面加以描述。许多被广泛引用的研究软件指标（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文基于49篇文献系统梳理了研究软件度量指标的全景，将其归纳为八大类并从数据来源、效度、自动化潜力和滥用风险等维度进行分析，同时指出AI辅助开发正使现有指标体系的假设面临失效。
en_tdlr: This paper synthesizes the research software metrics landscape from 49 references into eight metric families—analyzed by data source, validity evidence, automation potential, and misuse susceptibility—highlighting how AI-assisted development challenges the assumptions underlying existing metrics.
